subject: Acme - context length & token volume for pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Ortiz <sabrina.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Acme discovery follow-up: context length & token volumes

Hi Sabrina —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can size pricing and next steps: 

1) Workload profile requests
   - Primary use case: personalized product recommendations + short exploratory chat on product pages.
   - Expected traffic pattern: pilot ~50k requests/day, production target ~1.2M requests/day over 6–12 months.

2) Context & output needs (you mentioned this briefly on the call):
   - Avg prompt tokens: ~300 tokens (user prompt + recent session history)
   - Avg completion tokens: ~80 tokens (short responses / recommended items)
   - Percentiles: 95th completion length spikes to ~400 tokens for longer explanations
   - Context window: likely need 8k for Phase 1, evaluating 32k for power users / multi-turn debugging

3) Pricing & budget signals we heard on the call (help confirm):
   - Target unit economics: roughly $X / 1M tokens for cost targets — (can you confirm a target $/1M tokens or an annual budget range?)

4) Next steps
   - Sabrina: share token profile export (example CSV) and any skews by customer cohort (mobile vs web).
   - Jordan: will follow up with a short technical note on batching and latency expectations for 8k vs 32k context lengths.
   - Marissa/Vivek: propose a pilot package and preliminary $/1M token pricing once we get actual token profiles.

I've attached a token_profile.csv template (fill with prompt/completion samples if you can) and a draft SOW placeholder for budgetary discussion.

Thanks — quick replies are great so we can lock a pilot proposal this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: token_profile.csv (CSV - token samples), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (placeholder)

From: Sabrina Ortiz <sabrina.ortiz@acme.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme discovery follow-up: context length & token volumes

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few data points to confirm from our side: 

- Token profile: we've exported a small sample and attached it (see token_profile.csv). The sample is 2,000 sessions across web and mobile.
- Avg prompt tokens: 280 (web), 330 (mobile) — we gave the 300 ballpark on the call.
- Avg completion tokens: 70 median, mean ~95 due to a long-tail of explanation responses.
- 95th percentile completions: ~420 tokens (we see spikes when the recommender provides rationale).
- Context needs: Phase 1 = 8k window appears sufficient for 85% of sessions. About ~8% of heavy users would benefit from 32k. 128k is not required at this time.
- Budget: for pilot (3 months) we have an internal cap of $40k. Production budget TBD — leadership wants unit-econ targets first.

Can you put together a target $/1M tokens that maps to predictable monthly cost for the pilot given the sample? We're most interested in a conservative estimate (assume no prefix caching for pilot).

Sabrina
Sabrina Ortiz
Head of Product, Acme Retail
Sabrina.Oritz@acme.com

Attachment: token_profile.csv

Subject: Re: Acme discovery follow-up: context length & token volumes

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the sample and numbers, very helpful. A few technical clarifications that will affect pricing and latency tradeoffs: 

- Token accounting baseline: Redwood bills on tokens (prompt + completion). For modeling costs it's safest to use mean prompt + mean completion (we can provide 50/95th percentile cost estimates too).

- Caching: If you can enable prefix caching for frequently repeated product context (e.g., product descriptions, user profile vectors) we can reduce prompt token billing on average by ~15–25% depending on cache hit rate. That reduces effective $/1M tokens for the pilot.

- Batching and latency: with 8k context we can maintain 50–95ms p50 latency for small completions with our standard batchers at your projected QPS. Moving to 32k will increase per-request latency (p50 moves to ~80–150ms depending on batch size) and increase memory/cost per GPU. We can quantify exact token cost delta once we have the full token_profile.csv.

- Cost example (quick, conservative estimate using your pilot sample):
   - Mean tokens per request = 280 + 95 = 375 tokens/request
   - Pilot daily requests (sample basis): 50k/day -> 18.75M tokens/day -> ~562.5M tokens/month
   - If your pilot cap is $40k/month, target effective pricing needs to be ~ $71 / 1M tokens (562.5M tokens -> $40k budget) to fit within pilot cap.

This $/1M tokens number is a simple math example — we usually provide a tiered/committed pricing sheet and account for caching and batching improvements that lower effective spend.

I'll follow up with two attachments: (1) a simple calc sheet mapping token volumes to monthly cost at different $/1M tiers, and (2) a short note on 8k vs 32k latency/cost tradeoffs. Marissa — can you include this in the pilot proposal? Vivek — flagging for discount approval if they commit to a 6–12 month reserved volume.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Acme discovery follow-up: context length & token volumes

Thanks Sabrina — this is great and aligns with what we need. Summary & proposed next steps: 

Summary of numbers (from your sample)
- Avg prompt tokens: 280–330 (use 300 for pilot modeling)
- Avg completion tokens: 70–95 (use 95 for conservative model)
- Mean tokens/request: 375 (conservative)
- Pilot expected monthly tokens (estimate): ~560–600M tokens
- Pilot budget cap: $40k/month

Pricing ask / target
- To fit $40k/month at ~562.5M tokens, target effective price "~$71 / 1M tokens" as a conservative anchor.
- We'll model three pricing tiers for the pilot proposal: 
   A) Retail pilot (on-demand) — $85 / 1M tokens
   B) Committed 3-month pilot (10% discount) — $76.5 / 1M tokens
   C) Committed 6–12 month reserved (further discount; needs Vivek approval) — target ~$60–70 / 1M tokens depending on volume and caching commitments.

Context-length guidance
- Phase 1: 8k context (recommended) — covers ~85% of sessions and keeps latency lower.
- Phase 2: evaluate 32k for heavy users; we recommend a canary cohort to measure cost/latency impact before broad rollout.

Next steps
1) Sabrina / Raj: confirm you uploaded token_profile.csv (we received sample). If you can add a 7-day window of production traffic that helps accuracy.
2) Jordan: share calc sheet + 8k vs 32k note (Jordan to attach).
3) Marissa/Vivek: I will send a formal pilot proposal with the three pricing tiers and an SOW placeholder by EOD Monday.
4) If the pilot pricing looks good, we'll prepare a simple PO template for your procurement team to review.

Thanks — greenlight here and we'll move quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
